weapons.name: M4A1
weapons.why: Low recoil, common 5.56 ammo, lots of attachments. Best all-rounder to learn on.

weapons.name: M110A1
weapons.why: Semi-auto precision at mid–long range; takes suppressors. Also one of the most valuable guns to sell.

weapons.name: Origin-12
weapons.why: Box magazine means no shell-by-shell reloads. Best shotgun for repeat close fights.

weapons.name: Scorpion EVO 3
weapons.why: Very high fire rate with manageable recoil; shreds indoors. Light and sells well.

weapons.name: AEK-971
weapons.why: Around 900 RPM with less recoil than the AK-12.

weapons.name: SCAR-L
weapons.why: Very steady recoil; easy consecutive hits at mid range.

weapons.name: SCAR-H
weapons.why: 7.62×51 punch; a September update improved accuracy and added suppressor support.

weapons.name: M39 EMR
weapons.why: Less recoil than the M14 and a long rail.

weapons.name: SVDM
weapons.why: Accurate with quick follow-ups; integrated bipod.

weapons.name: PKM
weapons.why: Huge capacity for holding positions. Heavy, but sells for a lot. Can chamber a round since 0.4.0.201.

weapons.name: PP-2000
weapons.why: Takes modern optics and high-capacity mags.

weapons.name: AR416A5
weapons.why: Fast cycle for close fights; bursts work at mid range.

weapons.name: MP5
weapons.why: Lowest recoil around and strong hipfire. Great cheap close-quarters gun.

weapons.name: UMP45
weapons.why: Solid .45 SMG; dependable mid-tier sell value.

weapons.name: AK-103
weapons.why: Hard-hitting 7.62×39 but you have to control the recoil.

weapons.name: AK-12
weapons.why: Competitive AR with minor handling trade-offs.

weapons.name: XV ACP
weapons.why: .45 ACP with rapid fire; a top SMG pick.

weapons.name: SPAS-12
weapons.why: Fast semi-auto follow-ups, but heavy with a very slow full reload.

weapons.name: DP-12
weapons.why: Holds up to 14 shells; slow full reload.

weapons.name: M249 Para
weapons.why: Big box for suppression and squad defense.

weapons.name: M24
weapons.why: Practical bolt-action with a bipod.

weapons.name: SV-98
weapons.why: Strong bolt-action for one-shot long-range picks.

weapons.name: ASh-12
weapons.why: Situational heavy-caliber option.

weapons.name: EV-MG
weapons.why: Flexible attachment platform for sustained fire.

weapons.name: MB590
weapons.why: Cheap, reliable pump. Great PvE and Devourer-clearing backup; outclassed once you have an Origin-12.

weapons.name: SOK-94 Vepr
weapons.why: Beginner-friendly semi-auto; aimed shots.

weapons.name: M14
weapons.why: Powerful but outclassed by the M39 EMR.

weapons.name: AS Val
weapons.why: Integrally suppressed. Two of them sit in Military Base Armory #1.

weapons.name: VSS Vintorez
weapons.why: Integrally suppressed marksman rifle.

weapons.name: M82A1
weapons.why: Heavy with rare ammo. Lethality was boosted in 0.4.0.182, so it may be climbing.

weapons.name: Mosin Carbine
weapons.why: Budget backup; slow.

weapons.name: Hunting Crossbow
weapons.why: Silent takedowns.

weapons.name: CF-400 Flamethrower
weapons.why: Area denial with heavy movement penalty. Fire is excellent against Flowermen and Dendroids in Park.

weapons.name: RPG-7
weapons.why: Nerfed in 0.4.0.201: less projectile damage and rockets take more space. Not ranked by current lists.

items.name: Active Matter
items.why: Separate capacity, so it never costs backpack space. Fuels key and board crafting.

items.name: Investigation / objective items
items.why: Progression is worth more than any one sale. Head for extraction once you have them.

items.name: Keys
items.why: Turn a normal raid into a high-value one. Tiny (volume 10).

items.name: Notes & documents
items.why: Almost weightless; refine for about 50–65 Chronotraces each.

items.name: Cassette recorders & books
items.why: Around 1,000 credits each for very little space.

items.name: Cassettes (Space Work Universe, Black Iron, Driving Home, Back Again, Blackmail)
items.why: Ingredient for the Keys fuse recipe at Monolith Delta.

items.name: Accumulator batteries
items.why: Needed for the Lock actuator board and the Keys fuse recipe.

items.name: High-value guns
items.why: M110A1 (~13k), PKM (~11k, heavy), Scorpion EVO 3 (~5.5k, light).

items.name: Ceramic / Titan plates
items.why: Slot them into your armor first, then carry spares.

items.name: Rigs
items.why: A better rig than yours is a straight upgrade: more storage and smaller ammo.

items.name: Weapon recipe components
items.why: Smaller than the finished gun; refine into Chronotraces.

items.name: Medications
items.why: One pile restocks 100 medkit charges in one slot.

items.name: Fuses, damaged ammo, tools
items.why: Fuse/craft ingredients (Keys recipe, Underground lab key).

items.name: Gas cans
items.why: About 1,000 credits but heavy. Only near your exit.

items.name: Generic VHS tapes
items.why: Not the named cassettes; low value.

items.name: Binoculars, fire extinguishers, common scrap
items.why: Filler only. Never detour for them. Exception: carry a fire extinguisher into Ozernoe: Firestorm, where it neutralizes Scorches and burning Devourers.

rows.name: Titan
rows.note: Most durable in a long fight and much lighter than steel or ceramic; absorbs slightly less per hit than ceramic at first. Titan (S): durability 230, +45% projectile, +55% melee, +35% explosive. Fuse from 1 Ceramic (S) + chronotraces, or Replicator.

rows.name: Ceramic
rows.note: Highest initial absorption, heavier than titan. Commonly found at the Headquarters south gas station and signal posts.

rows.name: Steel
rows.note: Very durable but heavy. Sold at the Market.

rows.name: UHMWPE
rows.note: Basic; matches steel against melee but wears out faster.

rows.name: Rusty
rows.note: Lowest tier. Replace as soon as you can.

rows.name: Sizes: S, L, XL
rows.note: XL (Assault) fills a slot that used to take two L plates, with slightly less protection than a pair of L.

rows.name: Ballistic helmet TFMK-I
rows.note: Most bullet-resistant helmet; has an active headset. Late game.

rows.name: Enhanced Helmet EDH-Gen V
rows.note: Mid-game helmet with an active headset.

rows.name: SF, A3, IHPS, K6 / K6-3, PASGT, TRM-73, KVR
rows.note: Mid and early lootable helmets. No official ranking published.

rows.name: Tank crew helmet
rows.note: Common, light protection (+5% projectile) but takes night vision. In loot crates on all raids and in the Replicator.

rows.name: SSh-40, Stahlhelm, M1, Winter Hat
rows.note: Low-tier finds. Swap out early.

rows.name: Large Backpack
rows.note: Unlocked from the Monolith. The goal.

rows.name: Hiking & climbing packs
rows.note: Drop in general loot everywhere; most reported in Factory garages and Chagulko houses. Use them until you have the Large.

rows.name: Small / Medium
rows.note: Starter kit.

rows.name: Large Magazine Rig
rows.note: +600 storage and 30% smaller ammo and grenades. Shop 4,500 credits or 1,500 Monolith Tokens; also Replicator and Fusion.

rows.name: Large Rig / Medium Rig / Medium Magazine Rig
rows.note: Step-ups from the starter rig. Raid locations not documented yet.

rows.name: Small Medicine Rig
rows.note: Holds meds compactly; medical pockets take only medkits, injectors and painkillers.

rows.name: Small Rig / Small Magazine Rig
rows.note: Small Rig: +300 storage, smaller mags and grenades. Drops in every raid and in army crates; Shop 500 credits.

rows.name: Large safe container
rows.note: 150 volume. Contents teleport to your Shelter if you die.

rows.name: Medium safe container
rows.note: 100 volume. Shop (Prime).

rows.name: Small safe container
rows.note: 50 volume. Shop (Prime). One oversized item can fill it.

rows.name: Market
rows.note: Credits buy shop guns, plates, ammo and cheap consumables like AI-2 kits.

rows.name: Replicator
rows.note: Prints unlocked blueprints on a timer, such as plates and helmets.

rows.name: Fusion
rows.note: Upgrades items, e.g. Ceramic (S) plate into Titan (S).

patchNotes.change: Fall damage restored to intended values (a three-story roof drop is likely fatal); laser sights no longer point the wrong way during extraction.
Repair All also fixes spare armor in your rig, backpack or safe container; reloads can no longer exceed magazine capacity; map loot zones are colored by their rarest loot.
RPG-7 nerfed; PKM can chamber a round; muzzle flash hiders work again.
Pistol recoil restored to intended values.
M82A1 lethality boosted; armor and helmets resist melee better; large medkits buffed.
Molotovs and incendiary grenades ignite instantly.

order.why: Gunfire wakes Distorted and Flowermen and gives you away to players. A suppressor keeps fights small, and its weight and volume cost is tiny. Flash hiders hide your muzzle flash again since 0.4.0.201.
picks: Mini 556 or VZ1: light, for 5.56 rifles
BN45: strongest common suppressor for SMGs
M110A1 QD: for the M110A1 marksman build

order.why: Match it to the range you fight at. Higher zoom adds weight and volume and slows aiming.
picks: Close range: EXPS3 or M68 CCO collimator; PK-06 is the lightest
Mid range: TA31 or UTG T4 (4×)
Night, fog or smoke: S350F thermal

order.why: The biggest recoil and aim-recovery change you can make. Light stocks recover aim faster; heavy ones cut more recoil but slow ADS.
picks: F-Def GLC: best weight-to-recoil for AR-pattern rifles
MP PRS: most recoil reduction, slower aim
AK Tactical or PT-3: AK recoil

order.why: Useful indoors and at night. Since 0.4.0.196 the flashlight and laser toggle separately (both on L by default; rebind one).
picks: Run a flashlight for dark interiors
Laser for hipfire on SMGs and shotguns

order.why: Small handling tweak. Fit one if the slot is free; don't spend much on it.
picks: F-Def RTK angled, Gunslinger and Kuvalda grips are available

order.why: Most mags differ only in looks; capacity is what matters. Take the standard mag unless a bigger one is available.
picks: M4 and M4A1 mags have the same stats

builds.build: Suppressor, collimator, light stock, laser. Keep it light for fast aim.
Suppressor, LPVO or 4× scope, F-Def GLC stock, flashlight.
QD suppressor, 6× or 10× scope, heavier stock for recoil. Thermal for night raids.
Keep it light. Save heavy mods for your primary.

tips: You can only change mods in the Shelter (inventory or weapon wall).
Right-click a gun and choose Buy Ammunition and Mods to see only parts that fit.
If you die with a gun, its mods are lost with it.
Test builds in the Shelter shooting range before a raid.
Bulky optics and stocks cost volume you could use for loot.
